parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human TYK2 (CHEMBL3553) in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3553 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
